name: k12_mg1655_higherr
key_challenge: High-error stress (18%): one locus fragments into many short chains

simulation.notes: read_error is the per-base error-EVENT rate (substitutions + indel events); indel events average ~2 bp, so base-level edit divergence is ~1.7x the stated value. 0.18 is the midpoint of the 15-20% range in the handoff.

truth.simulated: reads_1.fq.truth.tsv beside the reads: read_id chrom true_start strand true_end n_subs n_ins n_del indel_events. true_start is the 0-based leftmost reference coordinate; true_end is half-open. Score placement within +/-100 bp (long_read_accuracy.py).

benchmark_notes: Compare unmapped fraction and PA against T9a; expect both to degrade, and look for a cliff rather than a slope.
